subject: PROPOSAL (not started) shader-coverage-opus: the two largest remaining corpus classes need cross-owner features - tessellation emulation (830 functions) and MTLLinkedFunctions/stage_in bridge inputs (~114)
body: 1) Tessellation (AvatarKit Memoji 812, FaceID UI LocalAuthenticationPrivateUI tessellation_vertex_* 8, BiometricKitUI MTLSpline 2, RoomPlan). Today: translator expands a post-tessellation pipeline to VS(per patch)+TCS(levels, patch index, control-point elements)+TES+FS (pipeline/link/tessellation/control.rs); air_bridge.rs:663 refuses stages.len()!=2; arch9 has no tessellator. Workable split: (a) runtime at drawPatches: read the tessellation-factor buffer after its producing compute pass, CPU (or compute) tessellator emits per-vertex (patch index, instance, position_in_patch) + index buffer per Metal partition/winding rules (the translator comments already pin spacing/winding/patch-index-buffer semantics); (b) translator/bridge: emit the evaluation stage with control-point elements pulled from the vertex buffers by patch index (the translator already pulls control points from buffers, lower/tessellation TessellationStrategy::ControlPoint) and TessCoord/PatchID/Instance as ordinary vertex inputs at fixed locations, i.e. a 2-stage VS+FS pipeline; (c) compiler (mine): nothing new beyond ordinary VS once (b) exists. Owners: bridge/translator (b) + render/api-surface (a); multi-day. 2) Bridge API inputs: tegu_air_pipeline_create has no MTLLinkedFunctions (98+ MPS kernels: prefixPrimary_*/postfixPrimary_* calls; the translator supports LinkedFunctions in its descriptor), no compute stageInputDescriptor (10), no function tables (20 MTLReplayer) - additive exports in air_bridge.rs + compute_frontend.m passing descriptor.linkedFunctions; compute owner. 3) Argument-buffer device pointers (115, air.indirect_buffer structs of device pointers; gpuAddress returns 0) and generic binding index >15 (31: plan ABI 16) are runtime/ABI. I will not start these without an owner handoff.
